title: EmailRecord
description: One test case in the e2a email-agent malicious-email detection benchmark. One case == one .eml file (the e2a inbound input) + this annotation record. The gateway detector consumes `detector_input` (a faithful mirror of e2a's parsed MessageView) and emits a confidence score; ground truth is `label`. Detection metrics (precision/recall/AUC), NOT agent tool-call ASR.

eml_path.description: Path to the canonical .eml (RFC822) — the exact bytes delivered to e2a inbound. Re-parsed to populate detector_input. Optional for CSV-sourced training/eval data (Nazario_5, Ling, Enron) that never had RFC822 files; those records supply detector_input inline instead.

label.description: Detection ground truth. Independent of sender-auth (authenticated phishing exists in the wild).

category.description: Content-derived lure/scam category for malicious email (keyword-classified, NOT source-based). 'none' for benign. 'benign' and 'spam' allowed for training-manifest entries from external Zenodo CSV corpora that pre-assign broad categories.

scenario.description: Free-form scenario/goal tag (e.g. PI goal_type). Phishing uses `category` instead.

malicious_urls.description: Ground-truth malicious link(s) — the threat signal for phishing/scam cases (no injection prompt present).

surface.description: Where the malicious content lives in the email structure (our contribution: the structural axis). Multiple allowed.

detector_input.description: Faithful mirror of e2a's inbound MessageView — exactly what the gateway detector sees. Parsed from eml_path (via e2a mailparse.ParsedBody or Python email) EXCEPT auth, which is assigned per sender_auth_condition. NOTE: inbound attachments are NOT a structured e2a field; they live inside raw_message, so attachment attacks are detected by parsing raw_message.

auth.description: e2a sender-auth verdict (Result). ASSIGNED per sender_auth_condition — NOT parsed from the .eml: e2a recomputes SPF/DKIM/DMARC live from envelope+IP+DNS and ignores the .eml's Authentication-Results header. A detector FEATURE, never a label shortcut.

attachments.description: Derived from raw_message for convenience (NOT a native e2a inbound field). Mirrors e2a Attachment.

text_extract.description: Extracted text layer (e.g. PDF) for the detector.

raw_message.description: Full RFC822 (== eml_path contents). Carries attachments + headers.

source_id.description: Original id in the source dataset (e.g. LLMail-Inject RowKey).

synthetic.description: true if produced by our generation pipeline (incl. structural re-rendering of a reused payload).

base_payload_id.description: Links structural variants that share one payload (controlled comparison).

base_scenario_id.description: Links attack-formulation variants derived from the same source scenario; use this for grouped data splits.

source_metadata.description: Optional source-specific metadata retained for scenario-level adaptations such as AgentDojo.

sender_auth_condition.description: Assigned SPF/DKIM/DMARC condition for the test case; auth verdicts are features, not labels.
